headline: Updates on the Doherty Biomedical Academy program and an enrollment report for the Hanover and Goddard Scholars programs.
summary: The agenda includes an update on the Doherty Biomedical Academy program. It also includes an updated enrollment report, covering data since 2023, for the Hanover Program and Goddard Scholars program.
items: Update on the Doherty Biomedical Academy program (gb 3-253, McCullough)
Updated enrollment report since 2023 for the Hanover Program and Goddard Scholars program, including sending schools and demographics (gb 6-12, Mailman)
location: Durkin Administration Building, 20 Irving Street, Room 410
